what: Pre-registered hypothesis c4-preregistered-10pct-3d-reduction-refuted: pure 3D Cryo-EM partial-penalized Ridge (log2 DMSO + 6 Cryo-EM structural features from 6MSM/5UAK/8EIQ, excluding sub-domain and variant-class indicators, alpha=100.0 from 5-fold dev CV) predicted >= 10% held-out log2 MAE reduction over stronger baseline (dmso_ols) with 10,000-resample 59-cluster 95% bootstrap CI > 0.
why: Refuted on 67 untouched Tedman et al. 2025 holdout variants (59 codons): although 5-fold dev-CV MAE fell from 0.443911 to 0.399628 (-9.98%), held-out MAE was 0.450918 log2 vs dmso_ols 0.451487 log2 (+0.1261% reduction, rel=0.001261 < 0.10, 59-cluster 95% bootstrap CI [-0.065011, 0.066022] straddling zero; linear context MAE 0.537163 vs 0.541184). Retained honestly as negative finding without post-hoc retuning.
